source: Project-authored illustration of Cheyne-Stokes breathing with crescendo-decrescendo depth and central pauses.
scope: A fixed-parameter teaching example, not a complete respiratory-control or gas-exchange model.

notes: Each group spans 11 original respiratory cycles: nine crescendo-decrescendo breaths followed by two empty cycles. The sequence and pause duration are authored; respiratory rate does not vary with depth.

coupling: Zero-depth slots emit no inspiration/expiration events. Resp and respiratory CVP components scale with depth; cardiac artifacts and events remain independent. CO2 above the inspired baseline follows a one-way, depth-driven reservoir response. The reservoir continues accumulating during apnea without new expiratory waves; existing tails and tubing delays continue.
limitations: Does not represent tidal volume or physiological feedback.
Does not change SpO2 or authoritative gas-exchange values.
No automatic respiratory-rate, EtCO2 or apnea detection.
Must not be combined with a manual respiratory-activity switching schedule.
Windows behavior is not yet manually verified.

co2Response.initialization: exact periodic orbit over 11 slots; rational calculation at plan creation
co2Response.quantization: gain permille, ties to even; applied to original expiration cycleIndex
co2Response.bounds: reject coupled physical peak above 327 mmHg; preserve inspired baseline
co2Response.status: time constant, reference depth and discrete response are authored teaching choices, not clinically calibrated
